case_name: State of Uttar Pradesh v Shobhanath and Others
facts: This appeal is directed against the judgment and order dated 07.04.2000 passed in Criminal Appeal No. 631 of 1984 whereby the Division Bench of the Allahabad High Court acquitted the respondents herein from the charges of offence punishable under Section 147, 148, 302 read with S. 149 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (for short
petitioner_arguments: The prosecution has failed to prove its case and consequently all the accused persons were acquitted.
respondent_arguments: There are discrepancies in the Injury Report and in the post mortem report as also in the x-ray report and that a number of injuries and their nature did not corroborate it with each other.
court_reasoning: The incident herein took place at about 5 p.m. on 2.11.1981. It was the month of November, but at 5 p.m., there would be still day light. ... The place of occurrence is near a betel shop where the deceased had gone for taking betel.
holding: The High Court acquitted all the accused persons of the aforesaid charges.
cases_cited: State of Uttar Pradesh v Shobhanath
